meta.name: gstack-learn
meta.description: GStack learn method for capturing reusable lessons, triggers, and future retrieval cues after debugging, implementation, or release work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录调试和发布后的经验教训，方便日后检索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在解决问题后忘记关键步骤和教训
copy.tagline_en: Capture reusable lessons after debugging or release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget key steps and lessons after solving problems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你完成调试、实现或发布工作后，主动帮你提炼可复用的经验教训、触发条件、证据和未来检索提示，并建议更新技能或记忆。
howto.when: 当出现可复用的经验教训、发现不应被遗忘的 bug 或工作流模式、需要为交接提供未来检索提示，或你明确说出“$gstack-learn”时触发。

say.text: 刚才修复了那个空指针异常，帮我用 gstack-learn 记录一下。
say.note: Claude 会提取教训、触发条件等。

say.text: 这个部署流程有个常见坑，用 gstack-learn 记下来。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you extract reusable lessons, triggers, evidence, and future retrieval cues after debugging, implementation, or release work, and suggest skill/memory updates if authorized.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a reusable lesson emerges, a bug or workflow pattern should not be rediscovered, handoff should include a future retrieval cue, or you explicitly say "$gstack-learn".

say_en.text: I just fixed that null pointer exception. Use gstack-learn to log it.
say_en.note: Claude will extract lesson, trigger, etc.

say_en.text: There's a common pitfall in this deployment flow. Record it with gstack-learn.
say_en.note: Claude will generate lesson and future reuse cue.
